messages:
Lia Chen: Quick heads-up — urgent patch needed for v1.9.10 to address a mem leak in KV cache. Minimal diff only: patch bump + single cherrypick. Planning an expedited cutoff in ~2h. Who can own the branch cut and smoke?
release-bot: Deploy window requested: expedited-hotpatch-1.9.10 scheduled for ~2 hours from now. Please ping @ops if you need warmup.
Tom B.: I can own the branch cut. Will create `release/1.9.10-hotpatch` and open a minimal PR with the cherrypick + version bump. ETA ~20m.
Sophie Park: We should add a tiny changelog line: "fix(kv): prevent leak on truncated seqs" — keep it one-liner.
Arjun Patel: Note: do NOT change quant flags for this release. Keep inference config identical to 1.9.9 so we only ship the leak fix.
Maria Gomez: I'm booking a 30m quiet window with SRE starting at the cutoff time. @ops-bot please gate traffic shift until manual thumbs-up from me.
Tom B.: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pulls/4132
Tom B.: Commands I ran:
```
git checkout -b release/1.9.10-hotpatch
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1234567890
# bump package.json version 1.9.9 -> 1.9.10
```
Sophie Park: Added the one-line CHANGELOG to the PR description and noted the minimal risk.
Lia Chen: Can someone run a short smoke after the canary? @Arjun?
Arjun Patel: Yep, I'll run the smoke (15m mem + 5m QPS soak) and post summary.
Tom B.: CI is green. Tests pass except an unrelated flaky test (test-x) — not blocking. Will hold merge until Lia says go.
Lia Chen: Merged the PR and tagged v1.9.10. Starting canary now. :rocket:
Maria Gomez: Canary @ +10m: no memory regression in traces I pulled, error rates stable. :thumbsup:
Arjun Patel: Smoke results: baseline (1.9.9) mem ~2.40GB, canary (1.9.10) mem ~2.35GB over 15m. No anomalies.
Lia Chen: Rolling to 25% and monitoring for 10m. If all good we'll cut GA.
Tom B.: Roll to GA completed. Changelog entry and release notes draft pushed. Nice quick turnaround. :tada:
Sophie Park: I'll finalize release notes and ping marketing for a short blurb.
Lia Chen: Thanks everyone — closing thread. Will reopen if any post-release issues crop up. :white_check_mark:
